data.summary:
Dynamic Technical Manager with 20+ years of IT experience and over 14 years leading large-scale Genesys Cloud CX & Genesys Engage solutions, platform migrations, and mission-critical operations. Adept at managing cross-functional engineering teams, driving cloud transformation, implementing AI automation, and ensuring seamless delivery for global BFSI and telecom enterprises. Recognized for technical leadership, stakeholder management, and delivering high-performing, scalable, resilient contact centre ecosystems.

Technical Team Leadership & Mentoring

Sprint Planning, Agile Delivery, Release Management

AWS Cloud Migrations (Engage on AWS)
Conversational AI: Voicebots, Chatbots, Agent Copilot
Network, VoIP & UC (Cisco, Avaya, AudioCodes)
Workflow Automation, REST APIs, Integrations
Infrastructure Readiness (VMware, Network, Security)

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Manager / Solution Architect – Contact Centre Platforms
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd | Bangalore | 2024 – Present

Leading end-to-end delivery of Genesys Cloud CX & Engage transformation programs.
Managing architects, engineers, and operations teams across multiple workstreams.
Overseeing AI automation delivery including voicebots, chatbots, Agent Copilot, and
knowledge-base systems.
Establishing delivery governance: backlog prioritization, release planning, RACI frameworks.
Coordinating with enterprise cloud, network, cyber security, and business owners to ensure
compliance and stability.
Driving API-led integrations with CRM, ticketing and enterprise systems.
Key Impact: Improved delivery predictability and reduced rework by establishing structured technical governance.
Technical Lead / Scrum Master – Genesys Cloud Migration Program
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd | 2019 – 2024

Led multi-year transformation to migrate large-scale BFSI contact centre workloads to Genesys Engage on AWS Cloud.
Orchestrated infrastructure readiness across networking, routing, telephony, and security domains.
Managed cross-functional squads and vendor partners; ensured delivery alignment with
architectural principles.
Drove sprint governance, capacity planning, and dependency management.
Conducted risk assessments, built mitigation plans, and ensured high platform availability.
Key Impact: Delivered a complex cloud migration program with zero customer-impacting outages.
Technical Lead – Contact Centre Operations & Enhancements
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd | Sydney | 2016 – 2019
Managed operations, lifecycle management, upgrade cycles, and capacity planning for
enterprise Genesys platforms.
Directed monitoring improvements, patching frameworks, and infrastructure modernization.

Led incident management, RCA, and cross-team issue resolution.
Coordinated with WFM, recording (Verint), and downstream ecosystem teams.
Key Impact: Reduced service incidents by 25% through automation and proactive monitoring.
Senior Communications Engineer – Genesys & Unified Communications
Tata Consultancy Services Ltd | Bangalore | 2010 – 2016
Delivered enterprise contact canter implementations using Genesys, Cisco Collaboration,
SIP, ESBC.
Authored HLD/LLD documents, executed POCs, and validated end-to-end call flows.

Supported multi-platform UC/Contact Centre ecosystems and enterprise integrations.
Telecom Engineer – VoIP & UC Systems
CSS Corp and others| Bangalore | 2002 – 2010
Managed Unified Communications and VoIP implementations (Cisco, Nortel, Alcatel-Lucent).

Supported large enterprise voice systems, EPABX, LAN/WAN environments.
